messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Elevated 502/504 rate detected for apigw-prod (eu-west-1). Current 5xx spike ~8x baseline. Pager: @lina_oncall. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/alerts/apigw-502s

lina_oncall: On call — joining. Devon & Sam, can you triage? Maria/ryan, please gather any customer-facing errors.

devon_r: joining. Looking at request fanout at the gateway — 10:12 UTC is where errors jump. Top downstream is mux-service and inference-proxy.

sam_runtime: I see connection pool saturation on mux nodes, lots of TIMEOUT -> 504s. Retries from gateway are amplifying fanout.

maria_sales: Sales alerted me: 3 customers reporting task-run failures and increased latency. Acme incident ticket ID #INC-7712. They saw 502s starting at ~10:15.

ryan_support: Confirmed multiple Zendesk tickets and a spike on our customer error dashboard. Customers seeing 502 JSON: {"error":"gateway_failure"} in our logs.

lina_oncall: Immediate mitigation options: 1) reduce gateway retries to 0 for affected route, 2) enable mux backpressure (reduce max_concurrency), 3) traffic shift away from eu-west-1 to eu-central if capacity available. Which one is fastest?

devon_r: Fastest is reducing gateway retries and enabling a mux circuit-breaker. I can push a config patch to the gateway in 90s. Will also throttle fanout when mux returns 429/timeout.

sam_runtime: I'll flip mux backpressure flag to lower max_inflight from 64 -> 16 on the affected pool. That should reduce connection pressure. Doing it now: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/pools/mux/flags -d 'max_inflight=16'`

ops-note (devops): executed `PATCH /gateway/config` to set retries=0 for route /v1/stream. New config applied to 3/4 nodes, rolling — see deploy bot: deploy-guard 6743214335 success.

devon_r: Confirmed gateway retries=0 rolled out. Also applied circuit-breaker: fail_open threshold lowered.

ryan_support: Customer reports reducing 502s for Acme. I'll update tickets: "We're seeing partial recovery, engineers applied mitigation; monitoring closely."

lina_oncall: Monitoring — Grafana shows 5xx down from 8x -> 2x in 3 minutes. Latency also dropping. Good sign. Keep throttles in place for 10 minutes, then incremental rollback if stable.

maria_sales: I'll ping top customers proactively with status note and ETA for full recovery.

devon_r: Post-mitigation snapshot: collecting heap/cpu on mux instances and traceback for connection resets. Hypothesis: a recent mux routing change increased per-request backend connections and removed an idle-connection pool optimization. I'll own root-cause follow-up.

sam_runtime: Temporary config kept. I'll prepare a rollback plan for the change that triggered pressure and add a canary test for connection pooling in the infra test harness.

lina_oncall: Action items: lina -> incident lead (timeline + comms); devon -> RCA & PR for pooling fix; sam -> update runbook with backpressure knobs; ryan -> customer comms; maria -> coordinate account-level outreach. I'll keep this thread open for 30m then escalate to postmortem. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — error rate trending down, severity lowered to P2 at 6743214475.

lina_oncall: Closing live triage. Will open a postmortem ticket and assign owners. Great quick work from everyone.
